mapper.select:
SELECT DATE(access_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_res_log WHERE status = '0'
GROUP BY DATE(access_time) ORDER BY DATE(access_time)

SELECT COALESCE(res_name, '其它') AS module_name, -- 金仓推荐用COALESCE替代IFNULL COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_res_log WHERE status = '0'
GROUP BY res_name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT res_id, res_title, res_name AS module, COUNT(*) AS views, DATE(MIN(access_time)) AS first_date FROM sys_res_log WHERE status = '0' AND res_id IS NOT NULL AND res_title IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY res_id, res_title, res_name ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '00-03' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '03-06' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 8 THEN '06-09' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 9 AND 11 THEN '09-12' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 12 AND 14 THEN '12-15' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 15 AND 17 THEN '15-18' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 18 AND 20 THEN '18-21' WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM access_time) BETWEEN 21 AND 23 THEN '21-24' END AS time_range, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_res_log WHERE status = '0'
GROUP BY time_range ORDER BY time_range

SELECT DATE(access_time) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS active_users FROM sys_res_log WHERE status = '0' AND user_name IS NOT NULL AND user_name != ''
GROUP BY DATE(access_time) ORDER BY DATE(access_time)
